entries.title: Your first mate keeps its folders when it moves between a Windows PC and a Mac
entries.body: When you move your first mate from a Windows PC to a Mac or a Linux computer, or the other way, each project now arrives in a folder with its own name, in the same place under your home folder, and each task points at its project and its conversation on the new computer. Before, a project from a Windows PC could arrive on a Mac in a folder named after its whole Windows location, and tasks kept pointing at folders that exist only on the old computer. A project that arrives beside a folder of the same name is now saved under the name it arrived with.
entries.noPicture: The fix changes where folders land on the disk and which locations the record saves; no view looks different.
